task.title: Delete a Sync
task.shortdesc: Permanently remove a sync configuration and its automatic schedule from the Syndication Service.

context.p: Deleting a sync removes its configuration and cancels any automatic schedule. Content that has already been published to the target system is not affected. This action cannot be undone.

step.cmd: In the navigation menu, click Syncs.
Click the name of the sync you want to delete.
In the confirmation dialog, confirm that you want to permanently delete the sync.
step.stepresult: The sync configuration and its schedule are permanently removed. You are redirected to the Syncs list.

result.p: The sync is deleted and no long available to use.

p.note: Deleting a sync does not remove content that was previously published to the target system. To remove published articles, you must do so directly in the target system.
